contract: v6 S2 transfer DIAGNOSTICS, preregistered before the runs. Same Path B protocol, readout and analysis as S1 (S1 thresholds reused as DIAGNOSTIC readouts only; transfer gains are not targets and decide nothing about the fit).
status_of_arm: S2-A is EXPLORATORY: inherits the REJECTED S1-A3 input stage; its medulla shape fit has validation NOT EVALUABLE; 8 of 12 tau_m sit on a bound (2 or 200 ms) and Ih vh sits on a bound for L1 and L2: boundary, non-identified effective parameters. S2-A-leak40 is a hypothetical, non-identifiable sensitivity (L1-L3 leak reversal -40 mV, pooled LMC bound).
engine: BrainV6 = v4 primary graded policy (v4-optic-lobe-graded), CPU, plus the frozen per-type parameters; only R1-R6 carry v6 parameters in S1
stimulus: Path B conditions C0 sham, C1 full-field ON (encoder 10 -> 20), C2 full-field OFF (10 -> 0), C3 column ON seeds 0-2; encoder level x 0.01 = light in BG0 units (10 = BG-1)
readout: right eye, COMPLETE columns, group mean dV in window E (0-50 ms) and S (50-200 ms) versus the 100 ms baseline; resp = the window with the larger magnitude

predictions_from_reduced_model.note: reduced single-cell lamina model of the A3 fit (BG-1 -> 2x step, mean over the step); predicts L2 BELOW the 5 mV threshold

verdict_rule: Each run is labelled DIAGNOSTIC PASS/FAIL against the S1 readout thresholds for comparability only; no stage PASS can follow (validation NOT EVALUABLE). Motion unopened.
compute: CPU, one numba thread, nice, taskset 0-3; no GPU

predictions_from_cutout.note: 7-column cutout, central-column step (not full field), mean dV over the step; directional only
